bio: Siturated in the heart of London's East End, The Angel Of Bow is an independent pub that prides itself in providing ethically and locally sourced produce.  Afternoon Tea is available on Friday and Saturday between 3pm and 5pm with a range of sandwiches, cakes, fancies and teas to choose from, for only £26.95 or £36.45 with a bubbly tipple!  The Angel of Bow is just a short walk from Devons Road station on the Docklands Light Railway, with easy access from the centre of London.
